about: Open-source personal finance manager, self-hosted and privacy-first.

prs.title: CSV imports pick one date order for the whole file
prs.broken: With the date format on auto, each row was read on its own. A US bank file got some dates day-first and others month-first, so transactions landed in the wrong months.
prs.changed: The import now decides the date order once from the whole column, the same way bank files in the QIF format already worked.
prs.matters: US exports import with every date in the right month and no silent mistakes.
